proposal.title: Generation of Maximally Entangled Two-Qubit Bell State |Phi+>
proposal.objective: Prepare and verify the canonical Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2) using single-qubit superposition and an entangling CNOT gate.
proposal.hypothesis: Unitary transformation CX(0,1) * (H(0) (x) I) acting on ground state |00> yields an equal superposition of |00> and |11> with zero cross-terms.

gates.name: H
gates.description: Hadamard gate on qubit 0 creating equal superposition

gates.name: CX
gates.description: CNOT gate with control 0 and target 1

assumptions: Ideal unitary gate execution without decoherence or depolarization
constraints: Standard computational Z basis projective measurement

author_claims.statement: Measurement outcomes 00 and 11 each have exactly 50% probability.
